title: I went to the worst of bars hoping to get killed. but all I could do was to get drunk again
designer: Ciarán Óg Arnold and Grégoire Pujade-Lauraine

description.main: Ciarán Óg Arnold’s first book, winner of the 2015 MACK First Book Award, photographs the drinkers of his home town of Ballinasloe, County Galway, in its bars and alleys after Ireland’s economic crash. Shot from 2009 on cheap film, mostly black and white; 76 pages, softcover with jacket, title from a Charles Bukowski poem.
description.extended:
Ciarán Óg Arnold’s first book, winner of the 2015 MACK First Book Award, follows the drinkers of his home town of Ballinasloe, County Galway, after Ireland’s crash.

Arnold began photographing the town in 2009, after losing his job in Galway and moving back home. He used the cheapest film the local discount shop sold, mostly black and white, and switched to colour when it ran out. The coarse paper turns the blacks grey. The sequence runs from empty streets and fields into bars under red light. Older men slump over drinks, young men square up to fight, and a girl stares back at the camera in the picture Arnold calls the book’s centre. The title is a line from Charles Bukowski’s poem The Suicide Kid. MACK issued it in May 2015 as a small paperback with a dust jacket, 76 pages at 22 by 16 cm. Arnold designed it with Grégoire Pujade-Lauraine, and the work was shown at Media Space, London, that spring.

Arnold was born in Ballinasloe in 1977. He took an MFA in photography at the University of Ulster in 2012, where Paul Seawright and Donovan Wylie pushed him to shape the pictures into a project. His work had appeared in An Irish View at the Rencontres d’Arles in 2009 and in Source magazine.
description.artist_bio: Ciarán Óg Arnold (b. 1977, Ballinasloe, Co. Galway) holds an MFA in Photography from the University of Ulster (2012). Exhibitions: MidLand, Gallery of Photography Dublin (2008); An Irish View, Rencontres d'Arles (2009); Gallery of Photography Artist Award exhibition (2012); First Book Award 2015, Media Space, London. Based in Sligo at the time of the book. Official site ciaranogarnold.com returns HTTP 401 (password-protected) as of 2026-10-18.
description.exhibition_context: First Book Award 2015 exhibition, Media Space, Science Museum, London, 20 April to 28 June 2015.
